claims.text: build rejects registry context mismatch and missing agents, memory or runs folds before snapshotting.
build projects at most 200 agents with truncated flag, truncated agent_version prefix and open, closed and last verdict telemetry.
main accepts only empty argv or --json and emits untrusted build output with ok and code on failure.

decision.rule: Change here when snapshot authority checks, agent projection fields, telemetry limits or the CLI wrapper needs to change.
decision.failure: A snapshot is built from mismatched folds, or a run contributes telemetry for an unknown agent.

questions.q: Where does build validate registry folds before projecting the snapshot?
Where should I change the 200-agent limit or telemetry fields?
Where can I debug a snapshot CLI error code?
